what_it_does: AutoMDT is a data transfer system that adapts to changing network and system conditions by automatically tuning how many concurrent operations run in parallel. It uses machine learning to optimize the balance between reading data from disk, transferring it over the network, and writing it to the destination. The system learns offline before deployment, so it doesn't slow down production networks. It solves the problem that traditional fixed transfer tools waste resources or become unstable when conditions change.
